title: CustomGlide CRM
text: A unified customer platform for enterprise clients, covering visual sales pipelines, marketing campaign execution, and service ticketing with real-time dashboards.

title: CustomGlide QR Ticketing
text: A QR ticketing and contactless entry system for visitor attractions: online booking, gateless scan-in validation, anti-replay ticket verification, and live visitor analytics.

title: Shayanomaly
text: Browser-based quantitative trading terminal streaming live order books from five exchanges and detecting cross-venue arbitrage.

title: deAIfy
text: A cross-platform tool that strips AI tells from text fully on-device, or rewrites text to sound human via a user-supplied LLM key.

title: Wordle Plus
text: Extends the daily word-guessing game with a shareable practice mode and an optional timed countdown.

title: GTA6.LLC
text: A static GTA 6 launch hub with a live countdown, pre-order guide, interactive map, and email capture.
